name: Duunitori
business_model: free basic listing or paid campaign per listing
notes: Operator Duunitori Oy in Helsinki. Basic listing is free; paid campaigns run 30 days (14 days for the lowest level). Site offers Finnish, English and Swedish job listings.

review.note: Employer, company and posting pages state the Helsinki address, language links and listing prices; no parent, partner programme or API mention found on those pages.
